welcome.es: Hola. Nuestros amiguitos tienen muchas ganas de jugar contigo.
welcome.en: Hello. Our little friends can't wait to play with you.

ending.es: Ya están todos dormiditos. Gracias por cuidarlos. Buenas noches.
ending.en: All our little friends are fast asleep. Thank you for taking care of them. Good night.

praise.es: Qué bien. Vamos a descubrir algo más.

moon.en: Hello, little moon. You look lovely.

story0.es: La lunita salió a pasear. Buscaba a sus amigos.
story0.en: The little moon went for a walk. She was looking for her friends.

story1.es: Los encontró muy juntitos, compartiendo un abrazo.
story1.en: She found them all together, sharing a lovely cuddle.

story2.es: Y les regaló un sueño bonito. Buenas noches, amiguitos.
story2.en: And she gave them a beautiful dream. Good night, little friends.

prop_bunny.es: Ponle la mantita a Luna para que esté calentita.
prop_bunny.en: Tuck Luna in with her blanket to keep her warm.

prop_kitten.es: Dale su cojín a Milo. Es tan blandito.
prop_kitten.en: Give Milo his pillow. It's so soft.

prop_bear.es: Nube quiere abrazar a su peluche.
prop_bear.en: Cloud would love to cuddle his toy bunny.

prop_puppy.es: Arropa a Coco con su mantita.
prop_puppy.en: Tuck Coco in with his little blanket.

prop_fox.es: Dale su dinosaurio de peluche a Pipa.
prop_fox.en: Give Pippa her cuddly toy dinosaur.

goodnight_bunny.es: Buenas noches, Luna. Qué calentita estás.
goodnight_bunny.en: Good night, Luna. You're so cozy.

goodnight_bear.es: Buenas noches, Nube. Tu peluche está contigo.
goodnight_bear.en: Good night, Cloud. Your little bunny is right beside you.

goodnight_puppy.es: Buenas noches, Coco. Sueña con muchas aventuras.
goodnight_puppy.en: Good night, Coco. Dream of lovely adventures.

goodnight_fox.es: Buenas noches, Pipa. Descansa con tu dinosaurio.
goodnight_fox.en: Good night, Pippa. Snuggle up with your dinosaur.

goodnight_panda.es: Buenas noches, Bambú. La luna cuida de ti.
goodnight_panda.en: Good night, Bamboo. The moon is watching over you.

activity_pet.es: Desliza el dedo para darle unas caricias.
activity_pet.en: Stroke your little friend with your finger.

activity_bubbles.en: So many bubbles! Tap them to make them pop.

activity_brush.es: Pasa el cepillo suavemente por su pelito.
activity_brush.en: Gently brush your little friend's fluffy fur.

activity_wash.es: Limpia las manchitas con el dedito.
activity_wash.en: Wipe the little smudges away with your finger.

activity_tidy.es: Guarda los tres juguetes en la cesta.
activity_tidy.en: Put the three little toys in the basket.

activity_stars.es: Enciende las tres estrellitas de la ventana.
activity_stars.en: Light up the three little stars by the window.

activity_snack.en: Give your little friend a little fruit.

activity_ball.es: Toca la pelota y mira cómo salta.
activity_ball.en: Tap the ball and watch it bounce.

activity_prop.en: Bring your little friend their favorite thing.

activity_kiss.es: Dale un besito de buenas noches.
activity_kiss.en: Give your little friend a goodnight kiss.

activity_lamp.es: Apaga la luz para que pueda descansar.
activity_lamp.en: Turn off the light so your little friend can rest.

activity_story.es: Vamos a leer un cuento. Toca para pasar la página.
activity_story.en: Let's read a little story. Tap to turn the page.

activity_song.es: Toca las cuatro notas para cantarle una nana.
activity_song.en: Tap the four notes to play a little lullaby.
